intro: Lesson 68: Energy stores, transfers and conservation. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: 4SD0-style question set : stores and transfers for six devices, conservation statements.
questions.a: Marked with the mark scheme on the portal sheet
questions.model: Teacher does the first device on screen: a hairdryer.

questions.q: A device takes in 500 J and wastes 150 J. How much is useful? Explain using conservation.
questions.a: 350 J; total out equals total in

questions.q: Explain why a perpetual motion machine cannot exist. (2)
questions.a: Energy is always dissipated (1) so the machine would need energy input to keep going (1)

questions.q: Describe the energy transfers when a bow fires an arrow upwards. (3)
questions.a: Elastic store of bow (1) transferred mechanically to kinetic store of arrow (1), then to gravitational store as it rises; some thermal by air resistance (1)
questions.model: Start store, transfer route, end stores, and the wasted part.

questions.q: A kettle: useful and wasted energy?
questions.a: Useful: thermal store of water; wasted: thermal store of kettle and air, sound
